change.title: IAM Failed-Login Lockout Enforcement
change.defect: IAM policy and schema defined max_failed_attempts, lockout_minutes and locked_until, but login only incremented failed_attempts and never enforced account lockout.
change.fix: Enforce configured failed-login threshold, set locked_until for the configured lockout duration, reject currently locked accounts before password/MFA processing, audit lockout events, and clear lockout state after successful authentication.
